Debate over India's 79th or 80th Independence Day celebration

Ahead of India's Independence Day on August 15, 2026, there is a discussion regarding whether it will be the 79th or 80th Independence Day. The confusion arises from whether to count the years since independence or the number of celebrations. Both Zee News and Dainik Jagran have published articles clarifying this point, indicating that August 15, 2026, will mark the 80th Independence Day celebration, representing 79 completed years of independence.
